title: Glucose-status modification of exercise ST depression: no established incremental CAD prediction across Cleveland and Hungary
abstract: Adding a fasting-glucose-flag × exercise-ST-depression term changed Hungarian Brier loss from 0.147639 to 0.148029 (delta +0.000390; source-refit/target bootstrap95% interval [-0.002110, +0.005158]); incremental benefit was not established. Source-only fitting used303 Cleveland patients and external evaluation262 Hungarian patients. The glucose flag is not a diabetes diagnosis. Reused cohorts make this exploratory independent-site evaluation, not untouched confirmation. The result is not equivalence or evidence against metabolic modification of ischemia.
